headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling maps tumor niche-immune interactions across cancers
label: Tumor Myeloid And Stromal Crosstalk
summary: Single-cell and spatial datasets are increasingly used to link tumor myeloid and stromal states to prognosis and treatment selection.
synthesis: The dominant thread is single-cell and spatial resolution of tumor-immune and stromal compartments, applied to prognosis, biomarker discovery and treatment selection. EvoNiche integrates 91 matched spatial and single-cell transcriptomic datasets across 35 cancer types to map tumor niche dynamics and spatiotemporal evolution. A 16-gene M2 macrophage-related breast cancer signature is built from scRNA-seq, spatial and bulk RNA-seq, while a five-gene mitochondrial metabolism RiskScore in colorectal cancer associates with survival and immune features. The adebrelimab neoadjuvant protocol in limited-stage SCLC pairs spatial single-cell and proteomic analyses with therapy. What is new here is the linkage of myeloid and stromal niche profiling to treatment selection, exemplified by a nine-gene-ratio transcriptome classifier (AUC 0.96) that predicts a hyper-methylated ccRCC subtype and may guide sunitinib and immunotherapy selection. Several items, including lncRNA biomarker studies, do not address immune niches directly.
